title: Billing Quick Reference — Owner Auto Policy Nonpayment Notice Figures
content:
**Owner Auto Policy: figures used for notices of cancellation for nonpayment, by package.**

| Package | Notice mailed this many calendar days after the unpaid installment's due date | Smallest unpaid past-due amount for which a notice is issued (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Cardinal Point Minimum Limits Liability | 1 | 5.00 |
| Cardinal Point 50/100/50 Liability | 1 | 5.00 |
| Cardinal Point 100/200/50 Liability | 3 | 10.00 |
| Cardinal Point 100/300/50 Liability | 3 | 10.00 |
| Cardinal Point 100/300/100 Liability | 5 | 15.00 |
| Cardinal Point 250/500/100 Liability | 5 | 15.00 |

- **Days after due:** the notice of cancellation for nonpayment is mailed this many calendar days after an installment's due date, with that installment still unpaid.
- **Smallest unpaid amount:** below this figure no notice is issued, and the amount rolls into the next bill.

**Figures common to every package.**
- **What rescinds a notice:** the full minimum amount due stated on the notice, received on or before the cancellation effective date.
- **When coverage ends:** 12:01 a.m. local time at the garaging address, on the cancellation effective date.

**Two quick readings (hypothetical).**
- An unpaid past-due amount of 9.50 on a Cardinal Point 100/200/50 Liability term is below that package's 10.00 figure, so it does not lead to a notice.
- The same 9.50 on a Cardinal Point Minimum Limits Liability term is above that package's 5.00 figure, so it does.
